findings.issue: GET /books/:id/reviews does not verify the book exists, unlike the sibling histogram route which 404s for unknown books.
findings.evidence: router.get('/books/:id/reviews', ...) calls Stats.getReviewsSorted(bookId, sort) with no Book.getBookById(bookId) check, while the next route '/books/:id/histogram' does check and 404s. GET /books/99999/reviews or /books/abc/reviews (NaN) returns 200 with [] instead of 404.
